description: Follow-up to catseye-fov. The fix added a language filter to SilentErrorSwallow, but several other OCaml-*-prefixed rules and rules in OCaml-context files lack the same defense-in-depth filter: MissingErrorContext (in src/ocaml/rules/ocaml_error_context.kdl:13-30), OCamlCommandInjection, OCamlShellInterpolation, OCamlUnsafeOperations, OCamlMarshalDeserialization. None of these are currently known to produce false positives, but a substring-sink change in any of them would be a latent FP. For each rule, verify the rule is OCaml-specific (sinks match OCaml syntax), add languages { include ocaml } if so, and add a regression fixture under test/samples/. Out of scope: the broader substring-match engine issue (separate ticket).
title: Audit and add languages { include ocaml } filters to all OCaml-*-prefixed and OCaml-scoped rules
